notes.title: Personal Finance Simulator is part of Steam Next Fest (2024 October)!
notes.notes: Personal Finance Simulator currently has an available demo for Steam Next Fest (October 2024)! If you give it a try, filling out the feedback form (button linked in-game) would be greatly appreciated!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898576/4733821578eebc5e51322fe6718a47ae311f5717.png[/img]
Mooncube Games (developer of Spirit City: Lofi Sessions), is hosting a Back to School Games Celebration. Personal Finance Simulator will be one of the participating games!
